developerBrief:
## Create AWS infrastructure components
**Spec Reference:** Section 6
### Context
The FORGE KB MCP Server requires AWS infrastructure components to be provisioned before deployment. This includes container registry, compute service, permissions, and load balancer configuration.
### Scope
- ECR repository for container images
- ECS Fargate service configuration
- IAM role with Bedrock permissions
- ALB target group and routing rules
- Environment variable configuration
### Technical Notes
- Use fortress-tools-cluster (existing)
- Start with 0.25 vCPU / 512MB (scale as needed)
- Resource scoping: bedrock-agent-runtime:* on * for MVP
### Dependencies
None
### Open Questions
None

title: As a developer, I want Entra OAuth token validation so that only authenticated FIP users can access MCP tools
description:
## Developer Brief — Entra OAuth Token Validation
**Spec Reference:** Section 4
### Context
All MCP endpoints (except /health) require valid Entra OAuth bearer tokens for authentication and authorization.
### Scope
- JWT signature verification against Entra JWKS
- Token claim validation (aud, tid, expiry)
- Middleware for protected endpoints
- Error responses for invalid tokens
### Technical Notes
- Use jsonwebtoken + jwks-rsa libraries
- Validate aud = ENTRA_CLIENT_ID
- Validate tid = ENTRA_TENANT_ID
- Extract oid, groups claims for entitlement checks
### Dependencies
MCP server scaffolding must be complete
### Open Questions
None
acceptanceCriteria: Authorization header with Bearer token is required for /mcp endpoints
JWT signature is verified against Entra JWKS endpoint
aud claim matches ENTRA_CLIENT_ID environment variable
tid claim matches ENTRA_TENANT_ID environment variable
Expired tokens return 401 Unauthorized
Invalid signatures return 401 Unauthorized
Missing Authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized
Valid tokens extract oid and groups claims for use by tools

title: As a developer, I want search_kb tool implemented so that clients can retrieve semantically relevant KB content
description:
## Developer Brief — search_kb Tool Implementation
**Spec Reference:** Section 3.1
### Context
Core KB search functionality using bedrock-agent-runtime:Retrieve with automatic security scoping based on KB type.
### Scope
- Implement search_kb MCP tool
- Auto-inject security filters by KB type
- Call bedrock-agent-runtime:Retrieve API
- Return formatted search results
### Technical Notes
- Use @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-agent-runtime
- Auto-scope Personal KB with user_id = token.oid
- Team KB requires team_id validation
- Project KB requires project_id validation
- Merge caller filters with auto-injected security filters
### Dependencies
Entra token validation must be working
### Open Questions
None
acceptanceCriteria: search_kb tool is registered with MCP server
Tool accepts query, kb_id, top_k, and filters parameters
Personal KB queries auto-inject user_id filter from token.oid
Team KB queries validate team membership before allowing access
Project KB queries require project_id and validate access
Corp and NEXUS KB queries have no additional filters
Results include content, metadata, and relevance_score fields
Invalid kb_id returns 400 UNKNOWN_KB error
Insufficient permissions return 403 NOT_ENTITLED error

description:
## Developer Brief — Metadata and Job Status Tools
**Spec Reference:** Section 3.4, 3.5
### Context
Two utility tools: get_kb_metadata for KB statistics and get_job_status for universal async polling.
### Scope
- Implement get_kb_metadata using GetKnowledgeBase + ListIngestionJobs
- Implement get_job_status for polling KB ingestion jobs
- Both tools require read entitlements
### Technical Notes
- get_kb_metadata derives last_updated from most recent completed job
- get_job_status is universal async contract for all FIP MCP servers
- Use in-memory job tracking for MVP
### Dependencies
add_to_kb must be working to generate job IDs
### Open Questions
None

Job status supports queued, running, complete, failed states
Job tracking works for KB ingestion jobs from add_to_kb
Both tools handle Bedrock API errors gracefully
